name: Real-Time Collaborative Whiteboard
description: A real-time collaborative whiteboard where multiple anonymous users can draw, add shapes and text, and edit the same board simultaneously, with every change synced live across all connected clients.
bulletPoints: Real-time multi-user sync via WebSockets (Socket.io): live cursors, element updates and a per-board user list broadcast instantly to everyone connected.
No accounts needed — each visitor is assigned an anonymous name and color for the session.
Board state persisted to MongoDB with debounced saves, so rapid edits don't hammer the database.
Single Express service serves both the API/WebSocket layer and the built React frontend, deployed as one combined Render web service.

name: Shop Inventory Management System
description: An inventory management system for our local village store to streamline the delivery acceptance process. The system enables staff to quickly search for products, verify incoming deliveries, replacing the previous manual paper-based workflow and significantly reducing the time required to process shipments.
bulletPoints: User-Interface with web technologies connected to a Python backend.
Automatically extracts product information from supplier delivery PDFs and converts it into structured JSON data.
Implemented a fast search system that allows staff to instantly locate products when validating deliveries, replacing the previous paper-list process and greatly reducing manual work.

name: Web-app - Roleplay Tavern
description: App for creating written role play games with other users.
bulletPoints: Data storage with MongoDB incl. uploading, changing and deleting data.
Practicing React and ExpressJS. Final version mainly with React.

name: Portfolio Website
description: A responsive, single-page portfolio, featuring a scroll-spy navigation system, JSON-driven project data for easy content updates, and a custom JavaScript game built from scratch and embedded directly into the page.
bulletPoints: Responsive design with a scroll-spy navigation system based on an intersection observer API.
Styled with Tailwind CSS and custom CSS for a fully responsive layout across mobile and desktop.
Showcase of projects based on JSON data.
Built a custom mini-game in vanilla JavaScript and embedded it as an interactive React component.
